title: Ellaz dungeon actor file
description: What an actor of a dungeon room IS: its body, its picture, its hp, how a hit throws it, and ONE behaviour block for its kind - `knight` (the hero the player drives), `slime` (hops and bites) or `bat` (hovers, swoops, retreats). Lengths are CENTI-TILES (100 = one tile), speeds centi-tiles per second, times ticks at the rules file's tickRate, heights view px; compile.ts turns each into FP or per-tick once, rounding a speed to the nearest FP per tick (2.8 tiles/s is 12). What the validator subset cannot write, data.test.ts asserts: exactly one behaviour block; `hover` REQUIRES `flying`; `facings` only with a `knight` block; `speed` REQUIRED with a `knight` block; dmgMin <= dmgMax.

sprites.description: the side-view set: a directory under ../assets/ holding <set>.png, .atlas.json, .manifest.json and .moves.json (an export set; copy-sprites holds it byte-identical to dist-export)

facings.description: a knight's front/back set under ../assets/ (png, atlas, manifest - no moves file) with idle_down, idle_up, walk_down, walk_up, attack_down, attack_up; the side set draws left, right and the ko

speed.description: a knight's walk, centi-tiles per second; a foe's speeds sit in its block

radius.description: the body's half-width in centi-tiles: the walls and props stop a body this wide

tall.description: view px above the feet where a damage float starts

bar.description: view px above the feet where the hp bar sits

flying.description: drawn `hover` px above its tile; a flier's shadow shrinks with its height

bobPx.description: cosmetic: a flier bobs this many px up and down ...

bobTicks.description: ... over this many ticks, as a triangle wave in the view

knockback.description: a hit throws the body away from the hitter at `speed`, and every tick the throw keeps `decay` of itself (exp(-12/60) is 82/100, exp(-10/60) is 85/100)

coins.description: the coins a fallen foe's body drops; absent means none

mpCost.description: a swing spends this; an empty orb still swings

afterTicks.description: ticks unhurt before the regen begins; a hit resets the count

reach.description: the strike lands on a foe closer than this ...

pointBlank.description: ... in front of the knight (the dot product of the facing and the direction to the foe, times 100, above `cone`) or closer than this on any side

cone.description: hundredths of the dot product; 25 is a cone about 150 degrees wide

dmgMax.description: the roll is dmgMin + one rng byte scaled into [0, dmgMax - dmgMin]

approach.description: a targeted foe closer than this is struck; farther, the knight walks the path to it

repathTicks.description: the path to a moving target is re-planned this often

aggro.description: the knight closer than this wakes it

speed.description: the hop, centi-tiles/s, applied only on walk frames hopFrom..hopTo (the airborne ones)

repathTicks.description: when the straight line to the knight is blocked, the path round is re-planned this often

biteAt.description: a bite begins when the knight is closer than this and the cooldown is over

biteReach.description: on the strike frame the bite lands within this

lungeSpeed.description: on attack frames lungeFrom..lungeTo the slime lunges at the knight while farther than lungeStop

strikeFrame.description: the attack frame on which the bite lands

cooldownTicks.description: after a bite lands, no bite for this long

pauseTicks.description: after the attack clip ends, no move for this long

hurtPauseTicks.description: after the hurt clip ends, no move for this long

walkAt.description: it walks while the knight is at least this far (a little under biteAt, so it does not flicker between the two)

speed.description: flies straight at the knight at most this fast, slowing as it closes: min(speed, gap * closeNum / closeDen)

everyTicks.description: a swoop comes this often while aggroed

range.description: ... and only when the knight is closer than this

beyond.description: the swoop aims this far past the knight

swoopAlt.description: view px: the swoop drops toward this height ...

swoopAltDiv.description: ... closing 1/this of the gap each tick

hit.description: while swooping, the knight within this takes dmg (if the cooldown is over) and the bat retreats

stop.description: a swoop that reaches within this of its aim retreats without a hit

retreatAlt.description: view px the retreat climbs toward, 1/retreatAltDiv of the gap per tick

edgePad.description: centi-tiles a bat keeps from the room's edge (it flies over props, never over the walls)
